title: Add matching values
summary: Tensor arithmetic can combine matching positions. Shapes must match or follow broadcasting rules.
introduction: Tensor arithmetic can combine matching positions. Shapes must match or follow broadcasting rules. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Tensor arithmetic can combine matching positions. Shapes must match or follow broadcasting rules.

blocks.code:
import torch

a = torch.tensor([1, 2])
b = torch.tensor([3, 4])
print((a + b).tolist())
blocks.title: Add matching values

blocks.text: The output is [4, 6]. The first values add together and so do the second values.
